notes: UAE English locale (/ae/, store 85009931, catalog 50333562). Akamai Bot Manager serves a JS interstitial; solved its proof-of-work (POST /_sec/verify?provider=interstitial) with curl_cffi chrome impersonation, then fetched every PLP directly - no proxy used. Zara Home renders no 'N items' header anywhere, so qty is the exact length of each PLP's own server-rendered grid payload (unique productIds in the serverApp-state transfer state), i.e. the full tile set the shopper scrolls. Every one of the 35 leaf counts was independently re-fetched from the itxrest category grid endpoint and matched exactly. Cross-checks: Glassware 'see all' (157) = Glasses (49) + Bottles and Jugs (37) + Tumblers (71) exactly; Lighting 'see all' (92) vs children union 88. Two real categories are omitted because the AE storefront publishes no working URL for them (both return HTTP 404 on their own SEO slug, which the site itself links): Tumblers (71 products, cat 1089117) and Cordless Lamps (21 products, cat 1020692636). Menu folder nodes (Tableware, Glassware, Table Accessories, Lamps and Lighting) have no grid of their own - the API 404s on them - so they are emitted as parent rows only. Excluded per brief: Fragrances/scented candles, rugs, cushions, throws, curtains, table linen, bedding, bathroom, furniture, cutlery, cookware/kitchen tools, storage baskets (seagrass baskets and hampers), jewellery/storage boxes, door knobs and handles (hardware), kids tableware (mixed with cutlery, placemats and paper napkins), and all See all / Bestsellers / Special Collection / Sale nav nodes. Zara Home AE lists no clocks category and no artificial plants category. Mirrors: the site's own 'Mirrors' landing (n993, 25 products) is treated as the parent grouping node; its five child listings carry the counts.
